title: Eliet's festivals
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: Eliet hangs paper lanterns for everyone who went down and came back. The traders give a little off, and the elder has a gift for those who walk the deep.
Bonfires in the square, and the smiths show off. A night for blades and bragging.
The whole village eats together under the big moon. The traders' carts are full and the prices are kind.
Candles in every window until dawn, for the ones who didn't come back. A night to sit and remember.
